Changelog

STATS230 0.5.0 (Homework 5)

New Features

  • Added function montecarlo_moments for estimating moments with either naive Monte Carlo or importance sampling, including Monte Carlo standard errors and confidence intervals.
  • Added function wright_fisher_path to simulate Wright-Fisher Markov chain paths with mutation.

Documentation

  • Added vignette covering Monte Carlo moment estimation and Wright-Fisher Markov chain analysis, including a derivation of the stationary mean and numerical verification.

STATS230 0.4.0 (Homework 4)

New Features

  • Added function em_mixture_normals which uses an expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm to estimate MLEs for parameters of a mixture of two normal distributions given some observations.
  • Added function occasionally_dishonest_casino which simulates a hidden Markov model (HMM) in which we observe the rolls of one of two dice: a loaded die, and a fair die, but we do not know which one is being used when. The function returns the hidden state of the die, the observed rolls, and the result of running the forward and backward algorithm on the observed rolls to estimate probabilities of the hidden state at each time.

Documentation

  • Added vignette in which there are two parts: in the first, the EM update formulas are derived and the implementation in em_mixture_normals is tested, and in the second, an HMM is simulated and the forward and backward algorithms are used to estimate marginal probabilities of the hidden state.

STATS230 0.3.0 (Homework 3)

New Features

  • Added function fit_logistic which uses three different optimization methods (Newton-Raphson (nr), Gradient Descent (gd), and Stochastic Gradient descent (sgd)) to compute MLEs for logistic regression coefficients.

Documentation

  • Added vignette demonstrating the usage of fit_logistic and plotting/benchmarking convergence.

STATS230 0.2.0 (Homework 2)

New Features

  • Added function rmvnorm to generate random samples from the multivariate normal distribution.
  • Added function dmvnorm to compute the density of the multivariate normal distribution using either Cholesky or Eigen decomposition methods.
  • Added function my_lm to fit ordinary least squares regression models using Cholesky, QR, or SVD matrix decomposition methods.

Documentation

  • Added vignette demonstrating the usage of rmvnorm, dmvnorm, and my_lm, along with benchmarking results comparing the computational efficiency of different methods for each function.

STATS230 0.1.0 (Homework 1)

New Features

  • Added function mult_ABx, which multiplies two square matrices and a vector. It has the option of using a more efficient method (A(Bx)) or a less efficient method ((AB)x).
  • Added function mult_Ainv_c, which computes the product of the inverse of a square matrix and a vector. It has the option of using a more efficient method (solve(A, c)) or a less efficient method (solve(A) %*% c).

Documentation

  • Added vignette walking through the usage of mult_ABx and mult_Ainv_c, and comparing computational efficiency of two methods for each.
